scope: Illustrative incremental cooling design, not a disclosed Microsoft site or company valuation

assumptions.water_intensity: Illustrative avoided direct cooling-water intensity; the similar 0.30 figure in MS2 has consumption/withdrawal wording ambiguity and is not treated as a calibrated site input.
assumptions.electricity: Constant IT load; extra facility electricity equals IT MWh times incremental PUE. No renewable matching or carbon-credit value assumed.
assumptions.benefit: Recurring pre-tax incremental operating cash benefit. Zero initially; break-even is solved, not forecast. Avoided disruption and enabled profit must not be double counted.
assumptions.tax: Straight-line tax depreciation over cooling-asset life, zero residual; all incremental deductions immediately usable against other taxable income. This is an assumption, not tax advice.
assumptions.timing: All incremental capex at time zero; operating cash flow and tax depreciation start after commissioning; benefits occur at year-end for the full asset life.
assumptions.exclusions: No terminal value, working-capital change, financing flows, delay holding costs, hardware replacement, carbon externality pricing, or quantified supply-chain water. These omissions require reassessment for actual underwriting.
